# Test fixtures

`testWORD.doc`, `testEXCEL.xls` and `testPPT.ppt` are Office 97–2003 sample documents from
[Apache Tika](https://github.com/apache/tika) (`tika-parser-microsoft-module/src/test/resources/test-documents`),
